task.title: Obtaining log information for Red Hat Quay
task.shortdesc: To obtain log information for your Red Hat Quay deployment and troubleshoot authentication, authorization, or object storage issues, you can use oc logs for Operator deployments or podman logs for standalone deployments. You can then search the Red Hat Knowledgebase or file a support ticket.
